title: Text to Speech
h1: Text to Speech — Read Text Aloud Free
seoTitle: Text to Speech — Free Online Speech Reader
description: Convert any text to spoken audio using your browser's built-in voices. Adjust rate and pitch, private and free.
intro: Paste text and hear it spoken aloud. Choose a voice, speed and pitch. Everything happens on your device using the Web Speech API.
blurb: Turn text into speech with your browser's voices. Free, private, no sign-up.

controls.label: Text to speak
controls.placeholder: Type or paste the text you want to hear…

howItWorks: Paste or type the text you want spoken into the box.
Adjust speed and pitch with the sliders if desired, then click Speak.
Your browser's speech engine reads the text aloud. Click Stop to interrupt.
examples: Have a long article or essay read aloud while you do other tasks.
Check pronunciation or listen to a draft of a speech or presentation.

faq.a: No. The Web Speech API runs entirely on your device. The text never leaves your browser.
The voices depend on your operating system and browser. Most modern browsers offer several languages and genders.
Make sure your device volume is up and the page is allowed to play audio. Some browsers require a user gesture (the Speak click) before starting speech.
